text: Unlike Egret-8, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Tern-9 is the Bergen datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Tern-9 applies to Egret-8, the datacenter differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Finance fixed the budget of Merlin-8 at $3400k, reviewed every quarter.

Unlike Shrike-5, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Egret-8 is 3600 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Egret-8 applies to Shrike-5, the rate limit differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
Plan around the retirement date of Osprey-6: March 9, 2028 is when it goes dark. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
Source for Bittern-6 is written in OCaml; no other language is allowed in its repository. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Unlike Tern-9, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Shrike-5 is 350 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Shrike-5 applies to Tern-9, the rate limit differs.
Finance fixed the budget of Shrike-5 at $1080k, reviewed every quarter.

Unlike Merlin-8, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Bittern-6 is June 22, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Bittern-6 applies to Merlin-8, the retirement date differs.
Unlike Tern-9, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Osprey-6 is the Ember team. Nobody should assume the owner of Osprey-6 applies to Tern-9, the owner differs.
All instances of Egret-8 live in the datacenter at Bergen. An older draft of this note was archived.
Questions about Tern-9 start with its owner, the Keystone team; they triage anything filed against it.
Plan around the retirement date of Merlin-8: June 15, 2027 is when it goes dark. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Egret-8 listens on port 4250; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules.
For Shrike-5 the port is 6466. Changing the port needs a change ticket. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
The pager rotation for Egret-8 is run by Jolene Whitlock; alerts page them first.
Pages from Osprey-6 land on the pager rotation of Farah Dunmore before anyone else.
Osprey-6 was granted a budget of $4585k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over. Details change slowly, so check the history first.

Unlike Osprey-6, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Merlin-8 is the Tessera team. Nobody should assume the owner of Merlin-8 applies to Osprey-6, the owner differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
The primary datacenter of Shrike-5 is Osaka; failover is handled by operations.
Merlin-8 is implemented in OCaml; the language was chosen for its tooling.
The yearly budget for Bittern-6 is $4095k, covering licences and hosting.
For Merlin-8 the port is 5892. Changing the port needs a change ticket. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
All instances of Bittern-6 live in the datacenter at Hanoi.
The language of Shrike-5 is Haskell, which new contributors must know.

Unlike Egret-8, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Tern-9 is Jolene Nakamura. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Tern-9 applies to Egret-8, the pager rotation differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Shrike-5, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Tern-9 is 3250 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Tern-9 applies to Shrike-5, the rate limit differs. An older draft of this note was archived.

Unlike Shrike-5, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Osprey-6 is Scala. Nobody should assume the language of Osprey-6 applies to Shrike-5, the language differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Tern-9 was granted a budget of $3800k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over.

Unlike Tern-9, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Bittern-6 is Oren Lindqvist. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Bittern-6 applies to Tern-9, the pager rotation differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

Unlike Merlin-8, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Egret-8 is the Trellis team. Nobody should assume the owner of Egret-8 applies to Merlin-8, the owner differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
